briefing.title: FIRST LIGHT
story: Marshal Corr: "Warden — your dropships are down and the crawlers are unpacking
the Construction Yard now. Nothing else survived the descent. You'll raise the
landing-zone base yourself: power, a refinery, a barracks — I'll walk you through it."
"One more thing. An Emberhand watch-post overlooks this valley from the north-east
ridge. When your base stands, take it out before they call in the desert."
Intercepted transmission — Sera Vane: "You call it a landing. We call it the first cut."
objectives: Raise the landing-zone base: Power, Refinery, Harvester, Barracks
Destroy the Emberhand watch-post on the north-east ridge
The Warden must survive (O selects, F1/F2 cast)

win: The watch-post is ash and the landing zone hums with industry.
You built this from a single Yard — but the sand is already whispering.
lose: The landing zone is overrun. The Reach will not forgive this.

objectives.text: Train a Harvester (H) at the Refinery

actions.speaker: Marshal Corr
actions.text: Power first, Warden. Press N — the node builds in your SIDEBAR. When it flashes READY, click open ground near the Yard to place it.

actions.speaker: Marshal Corr
actions.text: Node's humming. Now a Refinery (F) — it banks Shard and trains Harvesters. Give your buildings breathing room; crowded bases burn together.

actions.speaker: Marshal Corr
actions.text: Train a Harvester (H) at the Refinery. It works the Shard field to your east on its own — just keep it alive.

actions.speaker: Marshal Corr
actions.text: Income's flowing. Raise a Barracks (B) — that unlocks Infantry. Hover any sidebar button to see what it does and what it needs.

actions.speaker: Marshal Corr
actions.text: Base is standing — well done. Train Infantry (T), six or more, then push north-east. Box-select your squad and RIGHT-CLICK the watch-post.

actions.speaker: Marshal Corr
actions.text: You are on the field yourself, Warden. Press O to select yourself, F1 to RALLY your troops (+35% damage) and F2 to shield them. Lead from the front — but do not die.

actions.speaker: Sera Vane
actions.text: Little lights in the sand. Snuff them out.

actions.speaker: Marshal Corr
actions.text: Movement on the ridge — a probe is coming. Keep a couple of Infantry home to meet it.

actions.speaker: MARSHAL CORR
actions.text: Warden — you are bleeding out. Pull back NOW; this war does not survive you.

actions.speaker: Marshal Corr
actions.text: There — the watch-post on the north-east ridge. That is your target.
